resharper_align_multiline_expression_braces #

Align a wrapped braced expression with its opening brace. Not read by the C# formatter — one of the unprefixed spellings this export writes for the C++ and VB formatters. Measured at both values on a file with five wrapping initializers: the oracle returns it byte-identical. Negative control on the same file: resharper_csharp_wrap_object_and_collection_initializer_style = chop_always and resharper_wrap_array_initializer_style = chop_always both rewrite it, so the file can show an initializer moving.

Typetrue / false
Defaultfalse
Default known fromthe Rider export, which is Rider's default for most keys and the author's choice for the rest, with nothing distinguishing the two
TierD — recorded so the key is not reported unknown; nothing reads it yet
Languagecsharp
Since0.4
Documented athttps://www.jetbrains.com/help/resharper/EditorConfig_Index.html

resharper_expression_braces #

Where a break may land relative to an initializer's braces. Not read by the C# formatter. Measured at all four values on a file whose initializers wrap and whose } therefore sits on a line of its own — the shape a ParenthesesIndentStyle key would move — and the oracle returns it byte-identical each time, while the C# initializer wrap keys rewrite the same file.

Typeone of inside, outside, outside_and_inside, none

resharper_use_continuous_line_indent_in_expression_braces #

Whether an initializer's contents take a continuation level. Not read by the C# formatter: the C# spelling of this question is resharper_csharp_use_continuous_indent_inside_initializer_braces, which is implemented and observable. Measured at both values with the negative control described on resharper_align_multiline_expression_braces.

resharper_wrap_braced_init_list_style #

The braced initializer list's wrap style, in the language-generic spelling the export writes. Not read by the C# formatter. Measured at all three values; chop_always leaves a five-initializer file byte-identical, while resharper_wrap_array_initializer_style = chop_always and resharper_csharp_wrap_object_and_collection_initializer_style = chop_always both chop it one element per line. The C# keys are the ones to implement.

Typeone of wrap_if_long, chop_if_long, chop_always
Defaultwrap_if_long
Default known fromthe Rider export, which is Rider's default for most keys and the author's choice for the rest, with nothing distinguishing the two
